key_decisions: THE LESSON OF THIS SESSION: the app encodes fleet conventions in SHARED resolvers, and a model that breaks one fails SILENTLY with a plausible result. Four separate times. Every one was a title/class/widget-name assumption that held for LTX and WAN and not for H3. Before testing a model that breaks a shipped convention, GREP THE APP FOR THAT CONVENTION FIRST — docs/playbooks/add-model/README.md now carries this as a hard rule.

The stage node keeps the OLD title Input_Video_Latent rather than a new name. The app emits the dotted widget keys (Input_Video_Latent.is_continue/.is_preview/.load_path, the MPI-359 form) AND the plain latent-name key under that one title: a legacy graph consumes the plain half while the dotted keys match no widget; a migrated graph does the reverse. That is what lets LTX migrate on its own schedule instead of a flag day. The user chose this title; it is better than the Input_Stage_Latents I first proposed.
MpiStageLatents RAISES FileNotFoundError when a continue finds no latent, instead of blocking every branch. The silent block is precisely what produced the 0.03s no-output run that cost hours.

OUTPUT_NODE kept on the new node so ui.latents still reports and the app's /history collection is unchanged. It is free because check_lazy_status returns [] on a continue, so nothing upstream is dragged in.

The staging path (POST /comfy/stage-preview-latent -> engine input/) is KEPT — the user's explicit call. An absolute local path is meaningless on a RunPod Pod, so load_path must stay path-or-bare-name. The nodes already support both.

WAN twin deletion had to land WITH the singleFileStages flag, not before or after: unlike H3's missing file (404, loud), a stale twin on disk is FOUND AND RUN, silently producing the old graph's output.
constraints: NEVER hand-edit a workflow JSON. generate_*.py + node scripts/sync-raw-workflows.mjs own them.

js/services/*.js is RENDERER code — Ctrl+Shift+R, and a plain Ctrl+R can serve a CACHED ES module (that cost a full misdiagnosis this session; the probe that settles it is in the transcript: import models.js + resolveModelDeps.js in the console and print the resolved filename). routes/*.js is SERVER code and needs a full app restart.

Bench is 8188 (G:\ComfyUi\ComfyUI, saves workflows to user/default/workflows/); the APP engine is 48188. A node SCHEMA change needs a restart of whichever one must see it — a running ComfyUI keeps the old module.
sync-raw-workflows.mjs REFUSES to run while generated workflow files are uncommitted, because orchestrate.py rebuilds all templates. Commit or stash first.
The generated API + runtime files from the sync are STAGED, NOT COMMITTED — by the tool's own design, so /mpi-end makes ONE generated-workflow commit. They are staged right now.
Injection SILENTLY SKIPS a title matching no node, and _inject SPRAYS a plain key into every recognised widget name on a title-matched node. Both behaviours caused bugs this session.
Existing COLD previews never recover — status:'missing' is baked into each item's sidecar at save time. Delete them before re-testing or a stale failure reads as a live one.
H3's latent title must never contain 'audio' — _latentRoleFromTitle would tag it as the audio latent. Asserted in generate_h3.py AND pinned in tests/save-latent-recognition.test.cjs.
